question: Why are nonlinear activation functions important in neural networks?
direct_answer: They let the network represent complex, non-linear relationships.
expanded_answer: Without nonlinearity, the model can only bend data in limited ways. Nonlinear activations let each layer reshape and gate information, so stacked layers can build hierarchical representations instead of staying equivalent to a single linear model.
common_wrong_ideas: They are mainly for numerical stability only
Nonlinearity is only useful in output layers
